name: Quantum Engraving #009 — Submerged Quench
description:
Fire subdued by water: performing laser engraving submerged beneath a micro-layer of liquid water provides an intense 1000 W/m²·K thermal heatsink. Hydrodynamic cavitation sweeps away expelled melt, suppressing recast debris and confining crater depth to an immaculate 23.48 micrometers with mirror-smooth sidewalls.

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork visualizes convective boundary cooling and fluid-structure cavitation interactions.

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
